Short title and commencement

ACT XX OF 2004
ACT XX OF 2004
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2004]
No. PAP‑Legis.2(9)/2004/680,
dated 25‑9‑2004.‑‑The Provincial Motor Vehicles
(Amendment) Bill 2004, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 10 September 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
18 September 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
Preamble.‑‑Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
(XIX of 1965), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Provincial Motor
Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 49 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

ACT XX OF 2004
ACT XX OF 2004
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2004]
No. PAP‑Legis.2(9)/2004/680,
dated 25‑9‑2004.‑‑The Provincial Motor Vehicles
(Amendment) Bill 2004, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 10 September 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
18 September 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
Preamble.‑‑Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
(XIX of 1965), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
2. Amendment in section 49 of
Ordinance XIX of 1965.‑‑In the said Ordinance, in section 49,
subsection (2), clause (b), sub‑clause (i) shall be substituted‑by
the following:‑‑
"(i) the
applicant furnishes security issued by an insurance company duly registered
with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Insurance Division),
Islamabad with the Chairman of the Regional Transport Authority, to which the
application is made, for payment of any compensation that the applicant may be
required to pay under provision of section 67; or".
